items.title: Meta announces new VR Glasses and camera-free Ray-Ban Meta Audio
items.summary: Meta has announced two new pairs of smart glasses at Meta Connect 2026. The company unveiled its first camera-free, audio-only Ray Ban Meta Audio, along with a new pair of virtual reality glasses simply called Meta VR Glasses. The Meta VR Glasses use a two-part system, with the glasses housing the display and sensors, while a connected puck handles the computing and houses the storage and battery.

items.title: 打破谷歌 Pixel 独占，摩托罗拉 Signature 27 手机官宣支持 GrapheneOS 系统
items.summary: IT之家 9 月 24 日消息，GrapheneOS 官方昨天在 X 平台确认，摩托罗拉 Signature 27 将是首款支持 GrapheneOS 系统的非谷歌 Pixel 手机。 据IT之家此前报道 ，GrapheneOS 将于明年支持联想旗下摩托罗拉智能手机，开发团队初期将优先支持摩托罗拉传统直板旗舰机型，随后再扩展至折叠屏设备。 与普通安卓系统相比，GrapheneOS 更强调硬件级安全机制。系统会移除内置追踪功能，并将 Google Play 服务限制在隔离的应用沙箱中，同时加入系统级隐私保护功能，让用户能够更加自主地控制个人数据。
